page: Microsoft Azure EC32eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor configuration delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of system memory. This hardware allocation yields a 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual processor core, providing substantial volatile memory capacity for data-intensive processing without requiring dedicated GPU accelerators.

For high-throughput local scratch space and transactional responsiveness, the EC32eds_v6 bundles 1890 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. The instance family is also compatible with Azure Premium Storage, facilitating low-latency remote block storage integration alongside its high-capacity local disk. Network allocations include zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires virtual network routing or dedicated IP attachments for external communication.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of dense memory arrays, dedicated execution threads, and direct-attached NVMe storage minimizes infrastructure complexity for environments that would otherwise require external high-tier storage to meet performance targets. Because accelerator hardware is omitted, the architecture remains tailored for CPU-bound and memory-heavy systems. The EC32eds_v6 is suited for large relational database management systems, in-memory caching platforms, ETL processes, and analytical data workloads.
